title: Data Analyst
typical_interview_questions: Explain the difference between a LEFT JOIN and an INNER JOIN in SQL.
How would you handle missing or corrupt data in a dataset before analysis?
Can you describe a time you translated complex data findings into business insights?
What is the difference between descriptive and predictive analytics?
How do you design a SQL query to find the second highest salary in an employees table?
sample_JD_text: We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our team. You will write complex SQL queries, analyze user behavior, build dashboards in Tableau/PowerBI, and translate analytical insights into concrete business suggestions. Must be strong with SQL, python, and statistical basics.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
typical_interview_questions: What is overfitting, and how do you prevent it in a deep learning model?
Explain the bias-variance tradeoff.
How do you deploy a machine learning model to a production environment?
Describe how a Transformer-based language model works under the hood.
What metrics would you use to evaluate a highly imbalanced classification dataset?
sample_JD_text: Seeking an ML Engineer to build, scale, and deploy predictive models. You will design machine learning pipelines using PyTorch and Scikit-Learn, optimize models for inference, and work closely with backend engineers to integrate model APIs. Prior experience with Docker and model tracking tools is a plus.
